    38→

    44→  Cancelled: 'bg-orange-500 text-orange-100',
    45→};
    46→
    47→export function useTaskItemDisplay({
    48→  task,
    49→  parsedTaskParams,
    50→  promptText,
    51→  taskTypeDisplayName,
    52→  isVideoTask,
    53→  generationData,
    54→  videoOutputs,
    55→}: UseTaskItemDisplayArgs): UseTaskItemDisplayResult {
    56→  const taskWithDbFields = task as TaskWithDbFields;
    57→  const createdTimeAgo = useTaskTimestamp(task.createdAt || taskWithDbFields.created_at);
    58→  const processingTime = useRelativeTimestamp({
    59→    date: task.generationStartedAt || taskWithDbFields.generation_started_at,
    60→    preset: 'processing',
    61→  });
    62→  const completedTime = useRelativeTimestamp({
    63→    date: task.generationProcessedAt || taskWithDbFields.generation_processed_at,
    64→    preset: 'completed',
    65→  });
    66→
    67→  const displayTaskType = taskTypeDisplayName || getTaskDisplayName(task.taskType);
    68→  const abbreviatedTaskType = useMemo(
    69→    () => getAbbreviatedTaskName(displayTaskType),

    71→  );
    72→
    73→  const travelImageUrls = useMemo(() => {
    74→    if (!isVideoTask) {
    75→      return [];
    76→    }
    77→
    78→    const isIndividualSegment = task.taskType === 'individual_travel_segment';
    79→    const orchestratorDetails = parsedTaskParams.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    80→    const segmentImages = parsedTaskParams.input_image_paths_resolved;
    81→    const timelineImages = orchestratorDetails?.input_image_paths_resolved
    82→      || parsedTaskParams.input_image_paths_resolved;
    83→    const selected = isIndividualSegment ? segmentImages : timelineImages;
    84→
    85→    return Array.isArray(selected)
    86→      ? selected.filter((url): url is string => typeof url === 'string')
    87→      : [];
    88→  }, [isVideoTask, parsedTaskParams, task.taskType]);
    89→
    90→  const imagesToShow = travelImageUrls.slice(0, 4);
    91→  const extraImageCount = Math.max(0, travelImageUrls.length - imagesToShow.length);
    92→  const isImageEditTask = (IMAGE_EDIT_TASK_TYPES as readonly string[]).includes(task.taskType);
    93→  const shouldShowPromptPreview = Boolean(promptText && !isVideoTask && !isImageEditTask);
    94→  const promptPreviewText = promptText.length > 50
    95→    ? `${promptText.substring(0, 50)}...`
    96→    : promptText;
    97→  const variantName = isImageEditTask
    98→    ? undefined
    99→    : (isVideoTask ? videoOutputs?.[0]?.name : generationData?.name);
   100→
   101→  return {
   102→    createdTimeAgo,
   103→    processingTime,
   104→    completedTime,
   105→    abbreviatedTaskType,
   106→    travelImageUrls,
   107→    imagesToShow,
   108→    extraImageCount,
   109→    shouldShowPromptPreview,
   110→    promptPreviewText,
   111→    variantName,
   112→    statusBadgeClass: STATUS_BADGE_CLASS[task.status] || 'bg-gray-500 text-gray-100',
   113→  };
   114→}
   115→

1→import { useMemo } from 'react';
     2→import { type PaginatedTasksResponse } from '@/shared/hooks/tasks/useTasks';
     3→import { IncomingTask } from '@/shared/contexts/IncomingTasksContext';
     4→import { filterVisibleTasks } from '@/shared/lib/taskConfig';
     5→import { Task } from '@/types/tasks';
     6→import { FilterGroup } from '../constants';
     7→
     8→interface StatusCounts {
     9→  processing: number;
    10→  recentSuccesses: number;
    11→  recentFailures: number;
    12→}
    13→
    14→interface UseTaskFilteringArgs {
    15→  tasks: Task[];
    16→  incomingTasks: IncomingTask[];
    17→  activeFilter: FilterGroup;
    18→  statusCounts: StatusCounts | undefined;
    19→  paginatedData?: PaginatedTasksResponse;
    20→}
    21→
    22→interface UseTaskFilteringResult {
    23→  filteredTasks: Task[];
    24→  visibleIncomingTasks: IncomingTask[];
    25→  summaryMessage: string | null;
    26→  knownEmptyProcessing: boolean;
    27→  emptyMessage: string;
    28→}
    29→
    30→function getEmptyMessage(activeFilter: FilterGroup): string {
    31→  switch (activeFilter) {
    32→    case 'Processing':
    33→      return 'No tasks processing';
    34→    case 'Succeeded':
    35→      return 'No tasks succeeded';
    36→    case 'Failed':
    37→      return 'No tasks failed';
    38→    default:
    39→      return 'No tasks found';
    40→  }
    41→}
    42→
    43→export function useTaskFiltering({
    44→  tasks,
    45→  incomingTasks,
    46→  activeFilter,
    47→  statusCounts,
    48→  paginatedData,
    49→}: UseTaskFilteringArgs): UseTaskFilteringResult {
    50→  const filteredTasks = useMemo(() => filterVisibleTasks(tasks), [tasks]);
    51→
    52→  const visibleIncomingTasks = useMemo(() => {
    53→    if (activeFilter !== 'Processing' || incomingTasks.length === 0) {
    54→      return [];
    55→    }
    56→
    57→    const realTaskIds = new Set(filteredTasks.map((task) => task.id));
    58→    return incomingTasks.filter((incomingTask) => {
    59→      if (incomingTask.taskIds?.length) {
    60→        return !incomingTask.taskIds.some((id) => realTaskIds.has(id));
    61→      }
    62→      return true;
    63→    });
    64→  }, [activeFilter, filteredTasks, incomingTasks]);
    65→
    66→  const summaryMessage = useMemo(() => {
    67→    if (!statusCounts) {
    68→      return null;
    69→    }
    70→
    71→    if (paginatedData && paginatedData.totalPages > 1) {
    72→      return null;
    73→    }
    74→
    75→    if (activeFilter === 'Succeeded' && statusCounts.recentSuccesses > 0) {
    76→      return `${statusCounts.recentSuccesses} succeeded in the past hour.`;
    77→    }
    78→
    79→    if (activeFilter === 'Failed' && statusCounts.recentFailures > 0) {
    80→      return `${statusCounts.recentFailures} fails in the past hour.`;
    81→    }
    82→
    83→    return null;
    84→  }, [activeFilter, paginatedData, statusCounts]);
    85→
    86→  return {
    87→    filteredTasks,
    88→    visibleIncomingTasks,
    89→    summaryMessage,
    90→    knownEmptyProcessing: activeFilter === 'Processing' && statusCounts?.processing === 0,
    91→    emptyMessage: getEmptyMessage(activeFilter),
    92→  };
    93→}
    94→

1→import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
     2→import { TaskStatus, Task } from '@/types/tasks';
     3→import { FilterGroup } from '../constants';
     4→
     5→interface UseTaskListPresentationStateArgs {
     6→  tasks: Task[];
     7→  activeFilter: FilterGroup;
     8→  filterStatuses: TaskStatus[];
     9→  currentPage: number;
    10→  isLoading: boolean;
    11→}
    12→
    13→interface UseTaskListPresentationStateResult {
    14→  newTaskIds: Set<string>;
    15→  isFilterTransitioning: boolean;
    16→}
    17→
    18→const NEW_TASK_THRESHOLD_MS = 15000;
    19→const NEW_TASK_FLASH_MS = 3000;
    20→const FILTER_TRANSITION_SETTLE_MS = 300;
    21→
    22→export function useTaskListPresentationState({
    23→  tasks,
    24→  activeFilter,
    25→  filterStatuses,
    26→  currentPage,
    27→  isLoading,
    28→}: UseTaskListPresentationStateArgs): UseTaskListPresentationStateResult {
    29→  const [newTaskIds, setNewTaskIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
    30→  const [isFilterTransitioning, setIsFilterTransitioning] = useState(false);
    31→  const prevTaskIdsRef = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());
    32→  const prevFilterRef = useRef<FilterGroup>(activeFilter);
    33→  const prevPageRef = useRef<number>(currentPage);
    34→  const hasInitializedRef = useRef(false);
    35→
    36→  useEffect(() => {
    37→    if (prevFilterRef.current !== activeFilter) {
    38→      setIsFilterTransitioning(true);
    39→      prevFilterRef.current = activeFilter;
    40→    }
    41→  }, [activeFilter]);
    42→
    43→  useEffect(() => {
    44→    if (isFilterTransitioning && tasks.length > 0 && !isLoading) {
    45→      setIsFilterTransitioning(false);
    46→      return;
    47→    }
    48→
    49→    if (isFilterTransitioning && !isLoading && tasks.length === 0) {
    50→      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
    51→        setIsFilterTransitioning(false);
    52→      }, FILTER_TRANSITION_SETTLE_MS);
    53→      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    54→    }
    55→  }, [isFilterTransitioning, isLoading, tasks.length]);
    56→
    57→  useEffect(() => {
    58→    if (tasks.length === 0) {
    59→      return;
    60→    }
    61→
    62→    const currentIds = new Set(tasks.map((task) => task.id));
    63→    const isPaginationChange = prevPageRef.current !== currentPage;
    64→
    65→    if (!hasInitializedRef.current || isPaginationChange) {
    66→      prevTaskIdsRef.current = currentIds;
    67→      prevPageRef.current = currentPage;
    68→      hasInitializedRef.current = true;
    69→      return;
    70→    }
    71→
    72→    const now = Date.now();
    73→    const newlyAddedIds = tasks
    74→      .filter((task) => {
    75→        if (prevTaskIdsRef.current.has(task.id) || !task.createdAt) {
    76→          return false;
    77→        }
    78→        const createdTime = new Date(task.createdAt).getTime();
    79→        return now - createdTime < NEW_TASK_THRESHOLD_MS;
    80→      })
    81→      .map((task) => task.id);
    82→
    83→    if (newlyAddedIds.length > 0) {
    84→      setNewTaskIds(new Set(newlyAddedIds));
    85→      const timer = setTimeout(() => setNewTaskIds(new Set()), NEW_TASK_FLASH_MS);
    86→      prevTaskIdsRef.current = currentIds;
    87→      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    88→    }
    89→
    90→    prevTaskIdsRef.current = currentIds;
    91→  }, [currentPage, tasks]);
    92→
    93→  useEffect(() => {
    94→    prevTaskIdsRef.current = new Set();
    95→    prevPageRef.current = currentPage;
    96→    hasInitializedRef.current = false;
    97→  }, [currentPage, filterStatuses]);
    98→
    99→  return {
   100→    newTaskIds,
   101→    isFilterTransitioning,
   102→  };
   103→}
   104→

     5→interface TaskListSkeletonProps {

     9→
    10→function resolveSkeletonVariant(activeFilter: FilterGroup): 'processing' | 'complete' | 'failed' {
    11→  switch (activeFilter) {
    12→    case 'Succeeded':
    13→      return 'complete';
    14→    case 'Failed':
    15→      return 'failed';
    16→    case 'Processing':
    17→    default:
    18→      return 'processing';
    19→  }
    20→}
    21→
    22→export const TaskListSkeleton: React.FC<TaskListSkeletonProps> = React.memo(({
    23→  activeFilter,
    24→  count,
    25→}) => {
    26→  const skeletonCount = count !== undefined ? Math.min(count, 4) : 4;
    27→  const variant = resolveSkeletonVariant(activeFilter);
    28→  const skeletonItems = useMemo(
    29→    () => Array.from({ length: skeletonCount }, (_, i) => ({
    30→      variant,
    31→      showImages: i % 2 === 0,
    32→      showPrompt: i % 2 === 1,
    33→    })),
    34→    [skeletonCount, variant],

    37→  return (
    38→    <div className="space-y-1">

1→import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
     2→import { writeClipboardTextSafe } from '@/shared/lib/clipboard';
     3→
     4→export function useCopyToClipboard<T>(resetMs = 2000) {
     5→  const [copiedValue, setCopiedValue] = useState<T | null>(null);
     6→  const resetTimeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
     7→
     8→  useEffect(() => {
     9→    return () => {
    10→      if (resetTimeoutRef.current) {
    11→        clearTimeout(resetTimeoutRef.current);
    12→      }
    13→    };
    14→  }, []);
    15→
    16→  const copyText = useCallback(
    17→    async (text: string, copiedIndicator: T) => {
    18→      const copied = await writeClipboardTextSafe(text);
    19→      if (!copied) {
    20→        return false;
    21→      }
    22→
    23→      setCopiedValue(copiedIndicator);
    24→      if (resetTimeoutRef.current) {
    25→        clearTimeout(resetTimeoutRef.current);
    26→      }
    27→      resetTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
    28→        setCopiedValue(null);
    29→        resetTimeoutRef.current = null;
    30→      }, resetMs);
    31→      return true;
    32→    },
    33→    [resetMs]
    34→  );
    35→
    36→  return {
    37→    copiedValue,
    38→    copyText,
    39→  };
    40→}
    41→

     2→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     3→import { usePublicLoras } from '@/shared/hooks/useResources';

     6→interface UseTaskDetailsPresenterArgs {

     9→}
    10→
    11→export function useTaskDetailsPresenter({
    12→  task,
    13→  errorContext,
    14→}: UseTaskDetailsPresenterArgs) {
    15→  const [showDetailedParams, setShowDetailedParams] = useState(false);
    16→  const [showAllImages, setShowAllImages] = useState(false);
    17→  const [showFullPrompt, setShowFullPrompt] = useState(false);
    18→  const [showFullNegativePrompt, setShowFullNegativePrompt] = useState(false);
    19→  const [paramsCopied, setParamsCopied] = useState(false);
    20→  const [idCopied, setIdCopied] = useState(false);
    21→  const { data: availableLoras } = usePublicLoras();
    22→
    23→  const handleCopyParams = useCallback(async () => {
    24→    if (!task?.params) {
    25→      return;
    26→    }
    27→
    28→    try {
    29→      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(JSON.stringify(task.params, null, 2));
    30→      setParamsCopied(true);
    31→      setTimeout(() => setParamsCopied(false), 2000);
    32→    } catch (err) {
    33→      normalizeAndPresentError(err, { context: errorContext, showToast: false });
    34→    }
    35→  }, [errorContext, task?.params]);
    36→
    37→  const handleCopyId = useCallback((taskId: string | null) => {
    38→    if (!taskId) {
    39→      return;
    40→    }
    41→    navigator.clipboard.writeText(taskId);
    42→    setIdCopied(true);
    43→    setTimeout(() => setIdCopied(false), 2000);
    44→  }, []);
    45→
    46→  return {
    47→    availableLoras,
    48→    showDetailedParams,
    49→    setShowDetailedParams,
    50→    showAllImages,
    51→    setShowAllImages,
    52→    showFullPrompt,
    53→    setShowFullPrompt,
    54→    showFullNegativePrompt,
    55→    setShowFullNegativePrompt,
    56→    paramsCopied,
    57→    idCopied,
    58→    handleCopyParams,
    59→    handleCopyId,
    60→  };
    61→}

     3→import { pickFirstStructureGuidance } from '@/shared/lib/tasks/structureGuidance';

    18→const BUILTIN_PRESET_NAMES: Record<string, string> = {
    19→  __builtin_default_i2v__: 'Basic',
    20→  __builtin_default_vace__: 'Basic',
    21→};
    22→
    23→function pickString(...values: unknown[]): string | undefined {
    24→  for (const value of values) {
    25→    const parsed = asString(value);
    26→    if (parsed !== undefined) {
    27→      return parsed;
    28→    }
    29→  }
    30→  return undefined;
    31→}
    32→
    33→function parseNumberArray(value: unknown): number[] | undefined {
    34→  if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
    35→    return undefined;
    36→  }
    37→  const parsed = value
    38→    .map((item) => (typeof item === 'number' ? item : Number(item)))
    39→    .filter((item) => Number.isFinite(item));
    40→  return parsed.length > 0 ? parsed : undefined;
    41→}
    42→
    43→export function formatTravelModelName(name: string): string {
    44→  return name
    45→    .replace(
    46→      /wan_2_2_i2v_lightning_baseline_(\d+)_(\d+)_(\d+)/,
    47→      'Wan 2.2 I2V Lightning ($1.$2.$3)',
    48→    )
    49→    .replace(
    50→      /wan_2_2_i2v_baseline_(\d+)_(\d+)_(\d+)/,
    51→      'Wan 2.2 I2V Baseline ($1.$2.$3)',
    52→    )
    53→    .replace(/wan_2_2_i2v_lightning/, 'Wan 2.2 I2V Lightning')
    54→    .replace(/wan_2_2_i2v/, 'Wan 2.2 I2V')
    55→    .replace(/_/g, ' ');
    56→}
    57→
    58→export function resolveTravelPresetName(
    59→  presetId: string | undefined,
    60→  dbPresetName: string | null | undefined,
    61→): string | null {
    62→  if (!presetId) {
    63→    return null;
    64→  }
    65→  return BUILTIN_PRESET_NAMES[presetId] || dbPresetName || null;
    66→}
    67→
    68→interface UseVideoTravelTaskDataArgs {
    69→  taskParams: TaskDetailsProps['task']['params'];
    70→  inputImages: string[];
    71→  variant: TaskDetailsProps['variant'];
    72→}
    73→
    74→export interface VideoTravelTaskData {
    75→  isSegmentTask: boolean;
    76→  isAdvancedMode: boolean;
    77→  showPhaseContentInRightColumn: boolean;
    78→  effectiveInputImages: string[];
    79→  phaseConfig: UnknownRecord | undefined;
    80→  phaseStepsDisplay: string | null;
    81→  additionalLoras: UnknownRecord | undefined;
    82→  prompt: string | undefined;
    83→  enhancePrompt: string | undefined;
    84→  negativePrompt: string | undefined;
    85→  structureGuidance: UnknownRecord | undefined;
    86→  videoPath: string | undefined;
    87→  videoTreatment: string | undefined;
    88→  motionStrength: number | undefined;
    89→  styleImage: string | undefined;
    90→  styleStrength: number | undefined;
    91→  presetId: string | undefined;
    92→  isDbPreset: boolean;
    93→  modelName: string | undefined;
    94→  resolution: string | undefined;
    95→  frames: number | undefined;
    96→}
    97→
    98→export function useVideoTravelTaskData({
    99→  taskParams,
   100→  inputImages,
   101→  variant,
   102→}: UseVideoTravelTaskDataArgs): VideoTravelTaskData {
   103→  const parsedParams = useMemo(() => parseTaskParams(taskParams), [taskParams]);
   104→
   105→  return useMemo(() => {
   106→    const payloadSnapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(parsedParams);
   107→    const travelContractData = readTravelContractData(payloadSnapshot);
   108→    const rawParams = payloadSnapshot.rawParams;
   109→    const individualSegmentParams = payloadSnapshot.individualSegmentParams;
   110→    const derivedImages = deriveInputImages(rawParams);
   111→    const isSegmentTask = rawParams.segment_index !== undefined;
   112→    const contractInputImages = travelContractData.inputImages || [];
   113→
   114→    const effectiveInputImages = contractInputImages.length > 0
   115→      ? contractInputImages
   116→      : (isSegmentTask && derivedImages.length > 0)
   117→        ? derivedImages
   118→        : (inputImages.length > 0 ? inputImages : derivedImages);
   119→
   120→    const phaseConfig = asRecord(individualSegmentParams.phase_config)
   121→      || travelContractData.phaseConfig;
   122→    const phaseSteps = parseNumberArray(phaseConfig?.steps_per_phase);
   123→    const phaseStepsDisplay = phaseSteps && phaseSteps.length > 0
   124→      ? `${phaseSteps.join(' -> ')} (${phaseSteps.reduce((sum, current) => sum + current, 0)} total)`
   125→      : null;
   126→
   127→    const advancedMode = individualSegmentParams.advanced_mode
   128→      ?? travelContractData.advancedMode;
   129→    const motionMode = individualSegmentParams.motion_mode
   130→      ?? travelContractData.motionMode;
   131→    const hasPhaseConfig = Array.isArray(phaseConfig?.phases)
   132→      && phaseConfig.phases.length > 0;
   133→
   134→    const isAdvancedMode = advancedMode === false || motionMode === 'basic'
   135→      ? false
   136→      : advancedMode === true || motionMode === 'advanced' || motionMode === 'presets' || hasPhaseConfig;
   137→
   138→    const additionalLoras = asRecord(individualSegmentParams.additional_loras)
   139→      || travelContractData.additionalLoras;
   140→    const prompt = travelContractData.prompt || derivePrompt(rawParams);
   141→    const orchestratorNegativePrompts = asStringArray(payloadSnapshot.orchestratorDetails.negative_prompts_expanded);
   142→    const negativePrompt = asString(individualSegmentParams.negative_prompt)
   143→      || travelContractData.negativePrompt
   144→      || (
   145→        isSegmentTask
   146→          ? asString(rawParams.negative_prompt)
   147→          : (orchestratorNegativePrompts?.[0] || asString(rawParams.negative_prompt))
   148→      );
   149→
   150→    const enhancePrompt = pickString(
   151→      asString(payloadSnapshot.orchestratorDetails.enhance_prompt),
   152→      travelContractData.enhancedPrompt,
   153→      asString(rawParams.enhanced_prompt),
   154→    );
   155→
   156→    const structureGuidance = pickFirstStructureGuidance(
   157→      individualSegmentParams.structure_guidance,
   158→      travelContractData.structureGuidance,
   159→      asRecord(rawParams.structure_guidance),
   160→    );
   161→    const structureVideo = readTravelStructureVideoFromGuidance(structureGuidance);
   162→    const videoPath = pickString(
   163→      structureVideo?.path,
   164→      asString(payloadSnapshot.orchestratorDetails.structure_video_path),
   165→      asString(rawParams.structure_video_path),
   166→    );
   167→    const videoTreatment = pickString(
   168→      structureVideo?.treatment,
   169→      asString(payloadSnapshot.orchestratorDetails.structure_video_treatment),
   170→      asString(rawParams.structure_video_treatment),
   171→    );
   172→    const motionStrength = asNumber(structureGuidance?.strength)
   173→      ?? asNumber(payloadSnapshot.orchestratorDetails.structure_video_motion_strength)
   174→      ?? asNumber(rawParams.structure_video_motion_strength);
   175→
   176→    const styleImage = pickString(
   177→      asString(rawParams.style_reference_image),
   178→      asString(payloadSnapshot.orchestratorDetails.style_reference_image),
   179→    );
   180→    const styleStrength = asNumber(rawParams.style_reference_strength)
   181→      ?? asNumber(payloadSnapshot.orchestratorDetails.style_reference_strength);
   182→
   183→    const presetId = pickString(

   185→      travelContractData.selectedPhasePresetId,
   186→    );
   187→    const isDbPreset = Boolean(presetId && !presetId.startsWith('__builtin_'));
   188→
   189→    const modelName = pickString(travelContractData.modelName);
   190→    const resolution = pickString(
   191→      travelContractData.resolution,
   192→      asString(payloadSnapshot.orchestratorDetails.parsed_resolution_wh),
   193→      asString(rawParams.parsed_resolution_wh),
   194→    );
   195→    const parsedSegmentFrames = parseNumberArray(rawParams.segment_frames_expanded);
   196→    const frames = isSegmentTask

   199→        || asNumber(rawParams.num_frames)
   200→        || asNumber(rawParams.segment_frames_target)
   201→      )
   202→      : (travelContractData.segmentFramesExpanded?.[0] ?? parsedSegmentFrames?.[0]);
   203→
   204→    return {
   205→      isSegmentTask,
   206→      isAdvancedMode,
   207→      showPhaseContentInRightColumn: isAdvancedMode && hasPhaseConfig && variant === 'panel',
   208→      effectiveInputImages,
   209→      phaseConfig,
   210→      phaseStepsDisplay,
   211→      additionalLoras,
   212→      prompt,
   213→      enhancePrompt,

   221→      presetId,
   222→      isDbPreset,
   223→      modelName,
   224→      resolution,
   225→      frames,
   226→    };
   227→  }, [inputImages, parsedParams, variant]);
   228→}

   158→        name: loraName,
   159→        path: loraPath,
   160→        strength: 1.0,
   161→      }],
   162→    });
   163→  }, [effectiveLoras, onChange]);
   164→
   165→  const handleRemoveLora = useCallback((loraId: string) => {
   166→    const currentLoras = effectiveLoras;
   167→    onChange({
   168→      loras: currentLoras.filter(l => l.id !== loraId && l.path !== loraId),
   169→    });
   170→  }, [effectiveLoras, onChange]);
   171→
   172→  const handleLoraStrengthChange = useCallback((loraId: string, strength: number) => {
   173→    const currentLoras = effectiveLoras;
   174→    onChange({
   175→      loras: currentLoras.map(l =>
   176→        (l.id === loraId || l.path === loraId) ? { ...l, strength } : l
   177→      ),
   178→    });
   179→  }, [effectiveLoras, onChange]);
   180→
   181→  // handleSaveFieldAsDefault and savingField provided by useSaveFieldAsDefault hook above
   182→
   183→  // Computed values for motion default controls
   184→  const isUsingMotionModeDefault = settings.motionMode === undefined && !!shotDefaults?.motionMode;
   185→  const isUsingPhaseConfigDefault = settings.phaseConfig === undefined && !!shotDefaults?.phaseConfig;
   186→  const isUsingLorasDefault = settings.loras === undefined && (shotDefaults?.loras?.length ?? 0) > 0;
   187→  const isUsingMotionDefaults = isUsingMotionModeDefault && isUsingPhaseConfigDefault;
   188→
   189→  return (
   190→    <Collapsible open={showAdvanced} onOpenChange={setShowAdvanced}>
   191→      <CollapsibleTrigger asChild>
   192→        <Button

   195→          className={`w-full justify-between h-9 text-xs font-medium ${
   196→            showAdvanced

   198→              : 'bg-primary/10 text-primary hover:bg-primary/20 hover:text-primary'
   199→          }`}
   200→        >
   201→          <span>Advanced Settings</span>

   203→        </Button>
   204→      </CollapsibleTrigger>
   205→      <CollapsibleContent className={edgeExtendAmount === 6 ? '-mx-6' : '-mx-4'}>
   206→        <div className={`space-y-3 bg-muted/30 border-y border-border/50 ${edgeExtendAmount === 6 ? 'px-6 py-3' : 'px-4 py-3'}`}>
   207→          <PromptFieldsSection
   208→            settings={settings}

1→import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
     2→import {
     3→  BUILTIN_I2V_PRESET,
     4→  BUILTIN_VACE_PRESET,
     5→  detectGenerationMode,
     6→  SEGMENT_I2V_FEATURED_PRESET_IDS,
     7→  SEGMENT_VACE_FEATURED_PRESET_IDS,
     8→} from '@/shared/components/SegmentSettingsForm/segmentSettingsUtils';
     9→import type { SegmentSettings, SegmentSettingsFormProps } from '@/shared/components/SegmentSettingsForm/types';
    10→
    11→interface UseAdvancedSettingsStateParams {
    12→  modelName?: string;
    13→  settings: SegmentSettings;
    14→  shotDefaults?: SegmentSettingsFormProps['shotDefaults'];
    15→}
    16→
    17→export function useAdvancedSettingsState({
    18→  modelName,
    19→  settings,
    20→  shotDefaults,
    21→}: UseAdvancedSettingsStateParams) {
    22→  const [showAdvanced, setShowAdvanced] = useState(false);
    23→  const [isLoraModalOpen, setIsLoraModalOpen] = useState(false);
    24→
    25→  const generationMode = useMemo(
    26→    () => detectGenerationMode(modelName),
    27→    [modelName]
    28→  );
    29→  const builtinPreset = useMemo(
    30→    () => (generationMode === 'vace' ? BUILTIN_VACE_PRESET : BUILTIN_I2V_PRESET),
    31→    [generationMode]
    32→  );
    33→  const featuredPresetIds = useMemo(
    34→    () =>
    35→      generationMode === 'vace'
    36→        ? SEGMENT_VACE_FEATURED_PRESET_IDS
    37→        : SEGMENT_I2V_FEATURED_PRESET_IDS,
    38→    [generationMode]
    39→  );
    40→
    41→  const effectiveLoras = useMemo(() => {
    42→    if (settings.loras !== undefined) {
    43→      return settings.loras;
    44→    }
    45→    return shotDefaults?.loras ?? [];
    46→  }, [settings.loras, shotDefaults?.loras]);
    47→
    48→  return {
    49→    showAdvanced,
    50→    setShowAdvanced,
    51→    isLoraModalOpen,
    52→    setIsLoraModalOpen,
    53→    generationMode,
    54→    builtinPreset,
    55→    featuredPresetIds,
    56→    effectiveLoras,
    57→  };
    58→}

1→import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
     2→import { ONBOARDING_STEPS } from '@/shared/components/OnboardingModal/data/onboardingSteps';
     3→
     4→export function useOnboardingSteps(isOpen: boolean) {
     5→  const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState(1);
     6→  const [isShaking, setIsShaking] = useState(false);
     7→  const shakeTimeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
     8→
     9→  useEffect(() => {
    10→    if (isOpen) {
    11→      setCurrentStep(1);
    12→    }
    13→  }, [isOpen]);
    14→
    15→  useEffect(() => {
    16→    return () => {
    17→      if (shakeTimeoutRef.current) {
    18→        clearTimeout(shakeTimeoutRef.current);
    19→      }
    20→    };
    21→  }, []);
    22→
    23→  const handleNext = () => {
    24→    setCurrentStep((previous) => Math.min(previous + 1, ONBOARDING_STEPS.length));
    25→  };
    26→
    27→  const handleBack = () => {
    28→    setCurrentStep((previous) => Math.max(previous - 1, 1));
    29→  };
    30→
    31→  const handleShake = () => {
    32→    setIsShaking(true);
    33→    if (shakeTimeoutRef.current) {
    34→      clearTimeout(shakeTimeoutRef.current);
    35→    }
    36→    shakeTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => setIsShaking(false), 500);
    37→  };
    38→
    39→  const currentStepDefinition =
    40→    ONBOARDING_STEPS[currentStep - 1] ?? ONBOARDING_STEPS[0];
    41→  const stepTitles = ONBOARDING_STEPS.map((step) => step.title);
    42→
    43→  return {
    44→    currentStep,
    45→    isShaking,
    46→    handleNext,
    47→    handleBack,
    48→    handleShake,
    49→    currentStepDefinition,
    50→    stepTitles,
    51→  };
    52→}
    53→

1→import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
     2→import { writeClipboardTextSafe } from '@/shared/lib/clipboard';
     3→
     4→export function useCopyToClipboard<T>(resetMs = 2000) {
     5→  const [copiedValue, setCopiedValue] = useState<T | null>(null);
     6→  const resetTimeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
     7→
     8→  useEffect(() => {
     9→    return () => {
    10→      if (resetTimeoutRef.current) {
    11→        clearTimeout(resetTimeoutRef.current);
    12→      }
    13→    };
    14→  }, []);
    15→
    16→  const copyText = useCallback(
    17→    async (text: string, copiedIndicator: T) => {
    18→      const copied = await writeClipboardTextSafe(text);
    19→      if (!copied) {
    20→        return false;
    21→      }
    22→
    23→      setCopiedValue(copiedIndicator);
    24→      if (resetTimeoutRef.current) {
    25→        clearTimeout(resetTimeoutRef.current);
    26→      }
    27→      resetTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
    28→        setCopiedValue(null);
    29→        resetTimeoutRef.current = null;
    30→      }, resetMs);
    31→      return true;
    32→    },
    33→    [resetMs]
    34→  );
    35→
    36→  return {
    37→    copiedValue,
    38→    copyText,
    39→  };
    40→}
    41→

    12→  task,
    13→  errorContext,
    14→}: UseTaskDetailsPresenterArgs) {

    24→    if (!task?.params) {
    25→      return;

    33→      normalizeAndPresentError(err, { context: errorContext, showToast: false });
    34→    }

    42→    setIdCopied(true);
    43→    setTimeout(() => setIdCopied(false), 2000);
    44→  }, []);
    45→
    46→  return {
    47→    availableLoras,
    48→    showDetailedParams,
    49→    setShowDetailedParams,
    50→    showAllImages,
    51→    setShowAllImages,
    52→    showFullPrompt,

1→import { useMemo } from 'react';
     2→import { type PaginatedTasksResponse } from '@/shared/hooks/tasks/useTasks';
     3→import { IncomingTask } from '@/shared/contexts/IncomingTasksContext';
     4→import { filterVisibleTasks } from '@/shared/lib/taskConfig';
     5→import { Task } from '@/types/tasks';
     6→import { FilterGroup } from '../constants';
     7→
     8→interface StatusCounts {
     9→  processing: number;
    10→  recentSuccesses: number;
    11→  recentFailures: number;
    12→}
    13→
    14→interface UseTaskFilteringArgs {
    15→  tasks: Task[];
    16→  incomingTasks: IncomingTask[];
    17→  activeFilter: FilterGroup;
    18→  statusCounts: StatusCounts | undefined;
    19→  paginatedData?: PaginatedTasksResponse;
    20→}
    21→
    22→interface UseTaskFilteringResult {
    23→  filteredTasks: Task[];
    24→  visibleIncomingTasks: IncomingTask[];
    25→  summaryMessage: string | null;
    26→  knownEmptyProcessing: boolean;
    27→  emptyMessage: string;
    28→}
    29→
    30→function getEmptyMessage(activeFilter: FilterGroup): string {
    31→  switch (activeFilter) {
    32→    case 'Processing':
    33→      return 'No tasks processing';
    34→    case 'Succeeded':
    35→      return 'No tasks succeeded';
    36→    case 'Failed':
    37→      return 'No tasks failed';
    38→    default:
    39→      return 'No tasks found';
    40→  }
    41→}
    42→
    43→export function useTaskFiltering({
    44→  tasks,
    45→  incomingTasks,
    46→  activeFilter,
    47→  statusCounts,
    48→  paginatedData,
    49→}: UseTaskFilteringArgs): UseTaskFilteringResult {
    50→  const filteredTasks = useMemo(() => filterVisibleTasks(tasks), [tasks]);
    51→
    52→  const visibleIncomingTasks = useMemo(() => {
    53→    if (activeFilter !== 'Processing' || incomingTasks.length === 0) {
    54→      return [];
    55→    }
    56→
    57→    const realTaskIds = new Set(filteredTasks.map((task) => task.id));
    58→    return incomingTasks.filter((incomingTask) => {
    59→      if (incomingTask.taskIds?.length) {
    60→        return !incomingTask.taskIds.some((id) => realTaskIds.has(id));
    61→      }
    62→      return true;
    63→    });
    64→  }, [activeFilter, filteredTasks, incomingTasks]);
    65→
    66→  const summaryMessage = useMemo(() => {
    67→    if (!statusCounts) {
    68→      return null;
    69→    }
    70→
    71→    if (paginatedData && paginatedData.totalPages > 1) {
    72→      return null;
    73→    }
    74→
    75→    if (activeFilter === 'Succeeded' && statusCounts.recentSuccesses > 0) {
    76→      return `${statusCounts.recentSuccesses} succeeded in the past hour.`;
    77→    }
    78→
    79→    if (activeFilter === 'Failed' && statusCounts.recentFailures > 0) {
    80→      return `${statusCounts.recentFailures} fails in the past hour.`;
    81→    }
    82→
    83→    return null;
    84→  }, [activeFilter, paginatedData, statusCounts]);
    85→
    86→  return {
    87→    filteredTasks,
    88→    visibleIncomingTasks,
    89→    summaryMessage,
    90→    knownEmptyProcessing: activeFilter === 'Processing' && statusCounts?.processing === 0,
    91→    emptyMessage: getEmptyMessage(activeFilter),
    92→  };
    93→}
    94→

1→import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
     2→import { TaskStatus, Task } from '@/types/tasks';
     3→import { FilterGroup } from '../constants';
     4→
     5→interface UseTaskListPresentationStateArgs {
     6→  tasks: Task[];
     7→  activeFilter: FilterGroup;
     8→  filterStatuses: TaskStatus[];
     9→  currentPage: number;
    10→  isLoading: boolean;
    11→}
    12→
    13→interface UseTaskListPresentationStateResult {
    14→  newTaskIds: Set<string>;
    15→  isFilterTransitioning: boolean;
    16→}
    17→
    18→const NEW_TASK_THRESHOLD_MS = 15000;
    19→const NEW_TASK_FLASH_MS = 3000;
    20→const FILTER_TRANSITION_SETTLE_MS = 300;
    21→
    22→export function useTaskListPresentationState({
    23→  tasks,
    24→  activeFilter,
    25→  filterStatuses,
    26→  currentPage,
    27→  isLoading,
    28→}: UseTaskListPresentationStateArgs): UseTaskListPresentationStateResult {
    29→  const [newTaskIds, setNewTaskIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
    30→  const [isFilterTransitioning, setIsFilterTransitioning] = useState(false);
    31→  const prevTaskIdsRef = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());
    32→  const prevFilterRef = useRef<FilterGroup>(activeFilter);
    33→  const prevPageRef = useRef<number>(currentPage);
    34→  const hasInitializedRef = useRef(false);
    35→
    36→  useEffect(() => {
    37→    if (prevFilterRef.current !== activeFilter) {
    38→      setIsFilterTransitioning(true);
    39→      prevFilterRef.current = activeFilter;
    40→    }
    41→  }, [activeFilter]);
    42→
    43→  useEffect(() => {
    44→    if (isFilterTransitioning && tasks.length > 0 && !isLoading) {
    45→      setIsFilterTransitioning(false);
    46→      return;
    47→    }
    48→
    49→    if (isFilterTransitioning && !isLoading && tasks.length === 0) {
    50→      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
    51→        setIsFilterTransitioning(false);
    52→      }, FILTER_TRANSITION_SETTLE_MS);
    53→      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    54→    }
    55→  }, [isFilterTransitioning, isLoading, tasks.length]);
    56→
    57→  useEffect(() => {
    58→    if (tasks.length === 0) {
    59→      return;
    60→    }
    61→
    62→    const currentIds = new Set(tasks.map((task) => task.id));
    63→    const isPaginationChange = prevPageRef.current !== currentPage;
    64→
    65→    if (!hasInitializedRef.current || isPaginationChange) {
    66→      prevTaskIdsRef.current = currentIds;
    67→      prevPageRef.current = currentPage;
    68→      hasInitializedRef.current = true;
    69→      return;
    70→    }
    71→
    72→    const now = Date.now();
    73→    const newlyAddedIds = tasks
    74→      .filter((task) => {
    75→        if (prevTaskIdsRef.current.has(task.id) || !task.createdAt) {
    76→          return false;
    77→        }
    78→        const createdTime = new Date(task.createdAt).getTime();
    79→        return now - createdTime < NEW_TASK_THRESHOLD_MS;
    80→      })
    81→      .map((task) => task.id);
    82→
    83→    if (newlyAddedIds.length > 0) {
    84→      setNewTaskIds(new Set(newlyAddedIds));
    85→      const timer = setTimeout(() => setNewTaskIds(new Set()), NEW_TASK_FLASH_MS);
    86→      prevTaskIdsRef.current = currentIds;
    87→      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    88→    }
    89→
    90→    prevTaskIdsRef.current = currentIds;
    91→  }, [currentPage, tasks]);
    92→
    93→  useEffect(() => {
    94→    prevTaskIdsRef.current = new Set();
    95→    prevPageRef.current = currentPage;
    96→    hasInitializedRef.current = false;
    97→  }, [currentPage, filterStatuses]);
    98→
    99→  return {
   100→    newTaskIds,
   101→    isFilterTransitioning,
   102→  };
   103→}
   104→

1→import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
     2→import { FilterGroup } from '../constants';
     3→import { TaskItemSkeleton } from './TaskItemSkeleton';
     4→
     5→interface TaskListSkeletonProps {
     6→  activeFilter: FilterGroup;
     7→  count?: number;
     8→}
     9→
    10→function resolveSkeletonVariant(activeFilter: FilterGroup): 'processing' | 'complete' | 'failed' {
    11→  switch (activeFilter) {
    12→    case 'Succeeded':
    13→      return 'complete';
    14→    case 'Failed':
    15→      return 'failed';
    16→    case 'Processing':
    17→    default:
    18→      return 'processing';
    19→  }
    20→}
    21→
    22→export const TaskListSkeleton: React.FC<TaskListSkeletonProps> = React.memo(({
    23→  activeFilter,
    24→  count,
    25→}) => {
    26→  const skeletonCount = count !== undefined ? Math.min(count, 4) : 4;
    27→  const variant = resolveSkeletonVariant(activeFilter);
    28→  const skeletonItems = useMemo(
    29→    () => Array.from({ length: skeletonCount }, (_, i) => ({
    30→      variant,
    31→      showImages: i % 2 === 0,
    32→      showPrompt: i % 2 === 1,
    33→    })),
    34→    [skeletonCount, variant],
    35→  );
    36→
    37→  return (
    38→    <div className="space-y-1">
    39→      {skeletonItems.map((config, idx) => (
    40→        <React.Fragment key={idx}>
    41→          <TaskItemSkeleton {...config} />
    42→          {idx < skeletonItems.length - 1 && <div className="h-0 border-b border-zinc-700/40 my-1" />}
    43→        </React.Fragment>
    44→      ))}
    45→    </div>
    46→  );
    47→});
    48→

1→import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
     2→import { writeClipboardTextSafe } from '@/shared/lib/clipboard';
     3→
     4→export function useCopyToClipboard<T>(resetMs = 2000) {
     5→  const [copiedValue, setCopiedValue] = useState<T | null>(null);
     6→  const resetTimeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
     7→
     8→  useEffect(() => {
     9→    return () => {
    10→      if (resetTimeoutRef.current) {
    11→        clearTimeout(resetTimeoutRef.current);
    12→      }
    13→    };
    14→  }, []);
    15→
    16→  const copyText = useCallback(
    17→    async (text: string, copiedIndicator: T) => {
    18→      const copied = await writeClipboardTextSafe(text);
    19→      if (!copied) {
    20→        return false;
    21→      }
    22→
    23→      setCopiedValue(copiedIndicator);
    24→      if (resetTimeoutRef.current) {
    25→        clearTimeout(resetTimeoutRef.current);
    26→      }
    27→      resetTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
    28→        setCopiedValue(null);
    29→        resetTimeoutRef.current = null;
    30→      }, resetMs);
    31→      return true;
    32→    },
    33→    [resetMs]
    34→  );
    35→
    36→  return {
    37→    copiedValue,
    38→    copyText,
    39→  };
    40→}
    41→

     2→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';

    10→
    11→export function useTaskDetailsPresenter({
    12→  task,
    13→  errorContext,
    14→}: UseTaskDetailsPresenterArgs) {
    15→  const [showDetailedParams, setShowDetailedParams] = useState(false);
    16→  const [showAllImages, setShowAllImages] = useState(false);
    17→  const [showFullPrompt, setShowFullPrompt] = useState(false);
    18→  const [showFullNegativePrompt, setShowFullNegativePrompt] = useState(false);
    19→  const [paramsCopied, setParamsCopied] = useState(false);
    20→  const [idCopied, setIdCopied] = useState(false);
    21→  const { data: availableLoras } = usePublicLoras();
    22→
    23→  const handleCopyParams = useCallback(async () => {
    24→    if (!task?.params) {
    25→      return;
    26→    }
    27→
    28→    try {
    29→      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(JSON.stringify(task.params, null, 2));
    30→      setParamsCopied(true);
    31→      setTimeout(() => setParamsCopied(false), 2000);
    32→    } catch (err) {
    33→      normalizeAndPresentError(err, { context: errorContext, showToast: false });
    34→    }
    35→  }, [errorContext, task?.params]);
    36→
    37→  const handleCopyId = useCallback((taskId: string | null) => {
    38→    if (!taskId) {
    39→      return;
    40→    }
    41→    navigator.clipboard.writeText(taskId);
    42→    setIdCopied(true);
    43→    setTimeout(() => setIdCopied(false), 2000);
    44→  }, []);
    45→
    46→  return {
    47→    availableLoras,
    48→    showDetailedParams,
    49→    setShowDetailedParams,
    50→    showAllImages,
    51→    setShowAllImages,
    52→    showFullPrompt,
    53→    setShowFullPrompt,
    54→    showFullNegativePrompt,
    55→    setShowFullNegativePrompt,
    56→    paramsCopied,
    57→    idCopied,
    58→    handleCopyParams,
    59→    handleCopyId,
    60→  };

     3→import { pickFirstStructureGuidance } from '@/shared/lib/tasks/structureGuidance';

    18→const BUILTIN_PRESET_NAMES: Record<string, string> = {
    19→  __builtin_default_i2v__: 'Basic',
    20→  __builtin_default_vace__: 'Basic',
    21→};
    22→
    23→function pickString(...values: unknown[]): string | undefined {
    24→  for (const value of values) {
    25→    const parsed = asString(value);
    26→    if (parsed !== undefined) {
    27→      return parsed;
    28→    }
    29→  }
    30→  return undefined;
    31→}
    32→
    33→function parseNumberArray(value: unknown): number[] | undefined {
    34→  if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
    35→    return undefined;
    36→  }
    37→  const parsed = value
    38→    .map((item) => (typeof item === 'number' ? item : Number(item)))
    39→    .filter((item) => Number.isFinite(item));
    40→  return parsed.length > 0 ? parsed : undefined;
    41→}

    43→export function formatTravelModelName(name: string): string {

    45→    .replace(
    46→      /wan_2_2_i2v_lightning_baseline_(\d+)_(\d+)_(\d+)/,
    47→      'Wan 2.2 I2V Lightning ($1.$2.$3)',
    48→    )
    49→    .replace(
    50→      /wan_2_2_i2v_baseline_(\d+)_(\d+)_(\d+)/,
    51→      'Wan 2.2 I2V Baseline ($1.$2.$3)',
    52→    )
    53→    .replace(/wan_2_2_i2v_lightning/, 'Wan 2.2 I2V Lightning')
    54→    .replace(/wan_2_2_i2v/, 'Wan 2.2 I2V')
    55→    .replace(/_/g, ' ');
    56→}
    57→
    58→export function resolveTravelPresetName(
    59→  presetId: string | undefined,
    60→  dbPresetName: string | null | undefined,
    61→): string | null {
    62→  if (!presetId) {
    63→    return null;
    64→  }
    65→  return BUILTIN_PRESET_NAMES[presetId] || dbPresetName || null;
    66→}

    68→interface UseVideoTravelTaskDataArgs {
    69→  taskParams: TaskDetailsProps['task']['params'];
    70→  inputImages: string[];
    71→  variant: TaskDetailsProps['variant'];
    72→}
    73→
    74→export interface VideoTravelTaskData {
    75→  isSegmentTask: boolean;
    76→  isAdvancedMode: boolean;
    77→  showPhaseContentInRightColumn: boolean;
    78→  effectiveInputImages: string[];
    79→  phaseConfig: UnknownRecord | undefined;
    80→  phaseStepsDisplay: string | null;
    81→  additionalLoras: UnknownRecord | undefined;
    82→  prompt: string | undefined;
    83→  enhancePrompt: string | undefined;
    84→  negativePrompt: string | undefined;
    85→  structureGuidance: UnknownRecord | undefined;

    97→
    98→export function useVideoTravelTaskData({
    99→  taskParams,
   100→  inputImages,
   101→  variant,
   102→}: UseVideoTravelTaskDataArgs): VideoTravelTaskData {
   103→  const parsedParams = useMemo(() => parseTaskParams(taskParams), [taskParams]);
   104→
   105→  return useMemo(() => {
   106→    const payloadSnapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(parsedParams);
   107→    const travelContractData = readTravelContractData(payloadSnapshot);
   108→    const rawParams = payloadSnapshot.rawParams;
   109→    const individualSegmentParams = payloadSnapshot.individualSegmentParams;
   110→    const derivedImages = deriveInputImages(rawParams);
   111→    const isSegmentTask = rawParams.segment_index !== undefined;
   112→    const contractInputImages = travelContractData.inputImages || [];
   113→
   114→    const effectiveInputImages = contractInputImages.length > 0
   115→      ? contractInputImages
   116→      : (isSegmentTask && derivedImages.length > 0)
   117→        ? derivedImages
   118→        : (inputImages.length > 0 ? inputImages : derivedImages);
   119→
   120→    const phaseConfig = asRecord(individualSegmentParams.phase_config)
   121→      || travelContractData.phaseConfig;
   122→    const phaseSteps = parseNumberArray(phaseConfig?.steps_per_phase);
   123→    const phaseStepsDisplay = phaseSteps && phaseSteps.length > 0
   124→      ? `${phaseSteps.join(' -> ')} (${phaseSteps.reduce((sum, current) => sum + current, 0)} total)`
   125→      : null;
   126→
   127→    const advancedMode = individualSegmentParams.advanced_mode
   128→      ?? travelContractData.advancedMode;
   129→    const motionMode = individualSegmentParams.motion_mode
   130→      ?? travelContractData.motionMode;
   131→    const hasPhaseConfig = Array.isArray(phaseConfig?.phases)
   132→      && phaseConfig.phases.length > 0;
   133→
   134→    const isAdvancedMode = advancedMode === false || motionMode === 'basic'
   135→      ? false
   136→      : advancedMode === true || motionMode === 'advanced' || motionMode === 'presets' || hasPhaseConfig;
   137→
   138→    const additionalLoras = asRecord(individualSegmentParams.additional_loras)
   139→      || travelContractData.additionalLoras;
   140→    const prompt = travelContractData.prompt || derivePrompt(rawParams);
   141→    const orchestratorNegativePrompts = asStringArray(payloadSnapshot.orchestratorDetails.negative_prompts_expanded);
   142→    const negativePrompt = asString(individualSegmentParams.negative_prompt)
   143→      || travelContractData.negativePrompt
   144→      || (
   145→        isSegmentTask
   146→          ? asString(rawParams.negative_prompt)
   147→          : (orchestratorNegativePrompts?.[0] || asString(rawParams.negative_prompt))
   148→      );
   149→
   150→    const enhancePrompt = pickString(
   151→      asString(payloadSnapshot.orchestratorDetails.enhance_prompt),
   152→      travelContractData.enhancedPrompt,
   153→      asString(rawParams.enhanced_prompt),
   154→    );
   155→
   156→    const structureGuidance = pickFirstStructureGuidance(
   157→      individualSegmentParams.structure_guidance,
   158→      travelContractData.structureGuidance,
   159→      asRecord(rawParams.structure_guidance),
   160→    );
   161→    const structureVideo = readTravelStructureVideoFromGuidance(structureGuidance);
   162→    const videoPath = pickString(
   163→      structureVideo?.path,
   164→      asString(payloadSnapshot.orchestratorDetails.structure_video_path),
   165→      asString(rawParams.structure_video_path),
   166→    );
   167→    const videoTreatment = pickString(
   168→      structureVideo?.treatment,
   169→      asString(payloadSnapshot.orchestratorDetails.structure_video_treatment),
   170→      asString(rawParams.structure_video_treatment),
   171→    );
   172→    const motionStrength = asNumber(structureGuidance?.strength)
   173→      ?? asNumber(payloadSnapshot.orchestratorDetails.structure_video_motion_strength)
   174→      ?? asNumber(rawParams.structure_video_motion_strength);
   175→
   176→    const styleImage = pickString(
   177→      asString(rawParams.style_reference_image),
   178→      asString(payloadSnapshot.orchestratorDetails.style_reference_image),
   179→    );
   180→    const styleStrength = asNumber(rawParams.style_reference_strength)
   181→      ?? asNumber(payloadSnapshot.orchestratorDetails.style_reference_strength);
   182→
   183→    const presetId = pickString(
   184→      individualSegmentParams.selected_phase_preset_id,
   185→      travelContractData.selectedPhasePresetId,
   186→    );
   187→    const isDbPreset = Boolean(presetId && !presetId.startsWith('__builtin_'));
   188→
   189→    const modelName = pickString(travelContractData.modelName);
   190→    const resolution = pickString(
   191→      travelContractData.resolution,
   192→      asString(payloadSnapshot.orchestratorDetails.parsed_resolution_wh),
   193→      asString(rawParams.parsed_resolution_wh),
   194→    );
   195→    const parsedSegmentFrames = parseNumberArray(rawParams.segment_frames_expanded);
   196→    const frames = isSegmentTask
   197→      ? (
   198→        asNumber(individualSegmentParams.num_frames)
   199→        || asNumber(rawParams.num_frames)
   200→        || asNumber(rawParams.segment_frames_target)
   201→      )
   202→      : (travelContractData.segmentFramesExpanded?.[0] ?? parsedSegmentFrames?.[0]);
   203→
   204→    return {
   205→      isSegmentTask,
   206→      isAdvancedMode,
   207→      showPhaseContentInRightColumn: isAdvancedMode && hasPhaseConfig && variant === 'panel',
   208→      effectiveInputImages,
   209→      phaseConfig,
   210→      phaseStepsDisplay,
   211→      additionalLoras,
   212→      prompt,
   213→      enhancePrompt,
   214→      negativePrompt,
   215→      structureGuidance,
   216→      videoPath,
   217→      videoTreatment,

   220→      styleStrength,
   221→      presetId,
   222→      isDbPreset,
   223→      modelName,
   224→      resolution,
   225→      frames,
   226→    };
   227→  }, [inputImages, parsedParams, variant]);
   228→}

1→import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
     2→import {
     3→  BUILTIN_I2V_PRESET,
     4→  BUILTIN_VACE_PRESET,
     5→  detectGenerationMode,
     6→  SEGMENT_I2V_FEATURED_PRESET_IDS,
     7→  SEGMENT_VACE_FEATURED_PRESET_IDS,
     8→} from '@/shared/components/SegmentSettingsForm/segmentSettingsUtils';
     9→import type { SegmentSettings, SegmentSettingsFormProps } from '@/shared/components/SegmentSettingsForm/types';
    10→
    11→interface UseAdvancedSettingsStateParams {
    12→  modelName?: string;
    13→  settings: SegmentSettings;
    14→  shotDefaults?: SegmentSettingsFormProps['shotDefaults'];
    15→}
    16→
    17→export function useAdvancedSettingsState({
    18→  modelName,
    19→  settings,
    20→  shotDefaults,
    21→}: UseAdvancedSettingsStateParams) {
    22→  const [showAdvanced, setShowAdvanced] = useState(false);
    23→  const [isLoraModalOpen, setIsLoraModalOpen] = useState(false);
    24→
    25→  const generationMode = useMemo(
    26→    () => detectGenerationMode(modelName),
    27→    [modelName]
    28→  );
    29→  const builtinPreset = useMemo(
    30→    () => (generationMode === 'vace' ? BUILTIN_VACE_PRESET : BUILTIN_I2V_PRESET),
    31→    [generationMode]
    32→  );
    33→  const featuredPresetIds = useMemo(
    34→    () =>
    35→      generationMode === 'vace'
    36→        ? SEGMENT_VACE_FEATURED_PRESET_IDS
    37→        : SEGMENT_I2V_FEATURED_PRESET_IDS,
    38→    [generationMode]
    39→  );
    40→
    41→  const effectiveLoras = useMemo(() => {
    42→    if (settings.loras !== undefined) {
    43→      return settings.loras;
    44→    }
    45→    return shotDefaults?.loras ?? [];
    46→  }, [settings.loras, shotDefaults?.loras]);
    47→
    48→  return {
    49→    showAdvanced,
    50→    setShowAdvanced,
    51→    isLoraModalOpen,
    52→    setIsLoraModalOpen,
    53→    generationMode,
    54→    builtinPreset,
    55→    featuredPresetIds,
    56→    effectiveLoras,
    57→  };
    58→}

    10→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    11→import type { ShotImageManagerProps } from '@/shared/components/ShotImageManager/types';

    21→interface DesktopImageGridProps {

    42→
    43→export function DesktopImageGrid({
    44→  managerProps,
    45→  currentImages,
    46→  columns,

    48→  isMobile,
    49→  dragAndDrop,
    50→  selection,

    62→  lightboxPanel,

    98→              isMobile={isMobile}
    99→              duplicatingImageId={managerProps.duplicatingImageId}
   100→              duplicateSuccessImageId={managerProps.duplicateSuccessImageId}

   103→              onGridDoubleClick={() => {

   108→              isUploadingImage={managerProps.isUploadingImage}

   113→              defaultPrompt={managerProps.defaultPrompt}
   114→              defaultNegativePrompt={managerProps.defaultNegativePrompt}
   115→              onClearEnhancedPrompt={managerProps.onClearEnhancedPrompt}
   116→              pairOverrides={managerProps.pairOverrides}
   117→              activeDragId={dragAndDrop.activeId}

1→import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
     2→import { dispatchAppEvent } from '@/shared/lib/typedEvents';
     3→
     4→interface UseMobileImageSelectionParams {
     5→  readOnly: boolean;
     6→  onSelectionChange?: (hasSelection: boolean) => void;
     7→}
     8→
     9→export function useMobileImageSelection({
    10→  readOnly,
    11→  onSelectionChange,
    12→}: UseMobileImageSelectionParams) {
    13→  const [mobileSelectedIds, setMobileSelectedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
    14→  const [showSelectionBar, setShowSelectionBar] = useState(false);
    15→
    16→  const isInMoveMode = mobileSelectedIds.length > 0;
    17→
    18→  useEffect(() => {
    19→    if (mobileSelectedIds.length > 0) {
    20→      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
    21→        setShowSelectionBar(true);
    22→      }, 200);
    23→      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    24→    }
    25→    setShowSelectionBar(false);
    26→  }, [mobileSelectedIds.length]);
    27→
    28→  useEffect(() => {
    29→    const hasSelection = mobileSelectedIds.length > 0;
    30→    dispatchAppEvent('mobileSelectionActive', hasSelection);
    31→    onSelectionChange?.(hasSelection);
    32→
    33→    return () => {
    34→      dispatchAppEvent('mobileSelectionActive', false);
    35→    };
    36→  }, [mobileSelectedIds.length, onSelectionChange]);
    37→
    38→  const handleMobileTap = useCallback(
    39→    (imageId: string, _index?: number) => {
    40→      if (readOnly) {
    41→        return;
    42→      }
    43→
    44→      const wasSelected = mobileSelectedIds.includes(imageId);
    45→      if (wasSelected) {
    46→        setMobileSelectedIds((previous) =>
    47→          previous.filter((id) => id !== imageId)
    48→        );
    49→      } else {
    50→        setMobileSelectedIds((previous) => [...previous, imageId]);
    51→      }
    52→    },
    53→    [mobileSelectedIds, readOnly]
    54→  );
    55→
    56→  const clearSelection = useCallback(() => {
    57→    setMobileSelectedIds([]);
    58→    onSelectionChange?.(false);
    59→  }, [onSelectionChange]);
    60→
    61→  return {
    62→    mobileSelectedIds,
    63→    setMobileSelectedIds,
    64→    showSelectionBar,
    65→    isInMoveMode,
    66→    handleMobileTap,
    67→    clearSelection,
    68→  };
    69→}
    70→

1→import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
     2→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
     3→
     4→export function useMobileOptimisticOrder(images: GenerationRow[]) {
     5→  const [optimisticOrder, setOptimisticOrder] = useState<GenerationRow[]>([]);
     6→  const [isOptimisticUpdate, setIsOptimisticUpdate] = useState(false);
     7→
     8→  const currentImages =
     9→    isOptimisticUpdate && optimisticOrder.length > 0 ? optimisticOrder : images;
    10→
    11→  const prevImagesLengthRef = useRef(images.length);
    12→  useEffect(() => {
    13→    const lengthDiff = Math.abs(images.length - prevImagesLengthRef.current);
    14→    if (lengthDiff > 1 && isOptimisticUpdate) {
    15→      setIsOptimisticUpdate(false);
    16→      setOptimisticOrder([]);
    17→    }
    18→    prevImagesLengthRef.current = images.length;
    19→  }, [images.length, isOptimisticUpdate]);
    20→
    21→  useEffect(() => {
    22→    if (isOptimisticUpdate && images.length > 0) {
    23→      const optimisticIds = optimisticOrder.map((image) => image.id).join(',');
    24→      const serverIds = images.map((image) => image.id).join(',');
    25→
    26→      if (optimisticIds === serverIds) {
    27→        setIsOptimisticUpdate(false);
    28→        setOptimisticOrder([]);
    29→      } else {
    30→        const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
    31→          if (isOptimisticUpdate) {
    32→            setIsOptimisticUpdate(false);
    33→            setOptimisticOrder([]);
    34→          }
    35→        }, 5000);
    36→        return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
    37→      }
    38→    }
    39→  }, [images, isOptimisticUpdate, optimisticOrder]);
    40→
    41→  return {
    42→    currentImages,
    43→    optimisticOrder,
    44→    setOptimisticOrder,
    45→    isOptimisticUpdate,
    46→    setIsOptimisticUpdate,
    47→  };
    48→}
    49→

1→import { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
     2→import { ExpectedSegmentData, RawGenerationDbRow } from './segmentOutputTypes';
     3→
     4→export function extractExpectedSegmentData(
     5→  parentParams: Record<string, unknown> | null,
     6→): ExpectedSegmentData | null {
     7→  if (!parentParams) {
     8→    return null;
     9→  }
    10→
    11→  const orchestratorDetails = parentParams.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    12→  if (!orchestratorDetails) {
    13→    return null;
    14→  }
    15→
    16→  const segmentCount = (orchestratorDetails.num_new_segments_to_generate as number)
    17→    || (orchestratorDetails.segment_frames_expanded as unknown[] | undefined)?.length
    18→    || 0;
    19→
    20→  if (segmentCount === 0) {
    21→    return null;
    22→  }
    23→
    24→  return {
    25→    count: segmentCount,
    26→    frames: (orchestratorDetails.segment_frames_expanded as number[]) || [],
    27→    prompts: (orchestratorDetails.enhanced_prompts_expanded as string[])
    28→      || (orchestratorDetails.base_prompts_expanded as string[])
    29→      || [],
    30→    inputImages: (orchestratorDetails.input_image_paths_resolved as string[]) || [],
    31→    inputImageGenIds: (orchestratorDetails.input_image_generation_ids as string[]) || [],
    32→    pairShotGenIds: (orchestratorDetails.pair_shot_generation_ids as string[]) || [],
    33→  };
    34→}
    35→
    36→export function getPairIdentifiers(
    37→  generation: { pair_shot_generation_id?: string | null } | null,
    38→  params: Record<string, unknown> | null,
    39→): { pairShotGenId?: string; startGenId?: string } {
    40→  const columnValue = generation?.pair_shot_generation_id;
    41→  if (!columnValue) {
    42→    return {};
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  const individualParams = params?.individual_segment_params as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    46→  return {
    47→    pairShotGenId: columnValue,
    48→    startGenId: (individualParams?.start_image_generation_id || params?.start_image_generation_id) as string | undefined,
    49→  };
    50→}

    52→export function isSegmentGeneration(params: Record<string, unknown> | null): boolean {

    73→  };

1→import { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
     2→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     3→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     4→import { segmentQueryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys/segments';
     5→import { LiveTimelineRow, RawGenerationDbRow } from './segmentOutputTypes';
     6→import { transformToGenerationRow } from './segmentDataTransforms';
     7→
     8→export function buildParentGenerationsQueryKey(
     9→  shotId: string,
    10→  projectId: string | null,
    11→) {
    12→  return segmentQueryKeys.parents(shotId, projectId ?? undefined);
    13→}
    14→
    15→export async function fetchParentGenerations(
    16→  shotId: string,
    17→  projectId: string,
    18→): Promise<GenerationRow[]> {
    19→  const { data, error } = await supabase().from('shot_final_videos')
    20→    .select('*')
    21→    .eq('shot_id', shotId)
    22→    .eq('project_id', projectId)
    23→    .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
    24→
    25→  if (error) {
    26→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    27→      context: 'useSegmentOutputsForShot.fetchParents',
    28→      showToast: false,
    29→      logData: { shotId, projectId },
    30→    });
    31→    throw error;
    32→  }
    33→
    34→  return ((data || []) as unknown as RawGenerationDbRow[]).map(transformToGenerationRow);
    35→}
    36→
    37→export function buildChildrenQueryKey(selectedParentId: string): string[] {
    38→  return [...segmentQueryKeys.children(selectedParentId)] as string[];
    39→}
    40→
    41→export async function fetchChildGenerations(selectedParentId: string): Promise<GenerationRow[]> {
    42→  const { data, error } = await supabase().from('generations')
    43→    .select('*')
    44→    .eq('parent_generation_id', selectedParentId)
    45→    .order('child_order', { ascending: true })
    46→    .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
    47→
    48→  if (error) {
    49→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    50→      context: 'useSegmentOutputsForShot.fetchChildren',
    51→      showToast: false,
    52→      logData: { selectedParentId },
    53→    });
    54→    throw error;
    55→  }
    56→
    57→  return ((data || []) as unknown as RawGenerationDbRow[]).map(transformToGenerationRow);
    58→}

    61→  return segmentQueryKeys.liveTimeline(shotId);

    64→export async function fetchLiveTimeline(shotId: string): Promise<LiveTimelineRow[]> {
    65→  const { data, error } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    66→    .select('id, generation_id, timeline_frame')
    67→    .eq('shot_id', shotId)
    68→    .gte('timeline_frame', 0)
    69→    .order('timeline_frame', { ascending: true });
    70→
    71→  if (error) {
    72→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    73→      context: 'useSegmentOutputsForShot.fetchLiveTimeline',
    74→      showToast: false,
    75→      logData: { shotId },
    76→    });
    77→    throw error;
    78→  }
    79→
    80→  return (data || []) as LiveTimelineRow[];

     2→import { getPairIdentifiers } from './segmentDataTransforms';
     3→import { ExpectedSegmentData, LiveTimelineRow, SegmentSlot } from './segmentOutputTypes';
     4→
     5→interface BuildSegmentSlotsArgs {
     6→  segments: GenerationRow[];
     7→  expectedSegmentData: ExpectedSegmentData | null;
     8→  effectiveTimelineData: LiveTimelineRow[] | undefined;
     9→  liveShotGenIdToPosition: Map<string, number>;
    10→  localShotGenPositions?: Map<string, number>;
    11→  trailingShotGenId?: string;

    13→
    14→export function buildSegmentSlots({
    15→  segments,
    16→  expectedSegmentData,
    17→  effectiveTimelineData,
    18→  liveShotGenIdToPosition,
    19→  localShotGenPositions,
    20→  trailingShotGenId,
    21→}: BuildSegmentSlotsArgs): SegmentSlot[] {
    22→  const hasLocalPositions = !!localShotGenPositions && localShotGenPositions.size > 0;
    23→  const localPositionCount = localShotGenPositions?.size ?? 0;
    24→  const useLocalPositions = hasLocalPositions;
    25→  const positionMap = useLocalPositions ? localShotGenPositions : liveShotGenIdToPosition;
    26→  const baseSlotCount = useLocalPositions
    27→    ? localPositionCount - 1
    28→    : (effectiveTimelineData?.length ? effectiveTimelineData.length - 1 : 0);
    29→  const slotCount = trailingShotGenId ? baseSlotCount + 1 : baseSlotCount;
    30→
    31→  if (slotCount === 0) {
    32→    if (!effectiveTimelineData) {
    33→      return [];
    34→    }
    35→
    36→    return segments.map((child, index) => ({
    37→      type: 'child' as const,
    38→      child,
    39→      index: child.child_order ?? index,
    40→    }));
    41→  }
    42→
    43→  const slots: SegmentSlot[] = [];
    44→  const childrenBySlot = new Map<number, GenerationRow>();
    45→  const usedSlots = new Set<number>();
    46→  const childrenWithoutValidSlot: GenerationRow[] = [];
    47→
    48→  segments.forEach((child) => {
    49→    const childParams = child.params as Record<string, unknown> | null;
    50→    const { pairShotGenId } = getPairIdentifiers(child, childParams);
    51→    const childOrder = child.child_order;
    52→    const individualParams = (childParams?.individual_segment_params || {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
    53→    const endGenId = (individualParams.end_image_generation_id || childParams?.end_image_generation_id) as string | undefined;
    54→
    55→    let derivedSlot: number | undefined;
    56→    let slotSource = 'NONE';
    57→    let pairShotGenPosition: number | undefined;
    58→
    59→    if (pairShotGenId && positionMap.has(pairShotGenId)) {
    60→      pairShotGenPosition = positionMap.get(pairShotGenId)!;
    61→      const isTrailingSegment = trailingShotGenId && pairShotGenId === trailingShotGenId;
    62→
    63→      if (pairShotGenPosition < slotCount || isTrailingSegment) {
    64→        derivedSlot = pairShotGenPosition;
    65→        slotSource = isTrailingSegment
    66→          ? 'TRAILING_SEGMENT'
    67→          : (useLocalPositions ? 'LOCAL_POSITION' : 'PAIR_SHOT_GEN_ID_LIVE');
    68→      } else {
    69→        slotSource = 'PAIR_AT_END_NO_SLOT';
    70→      }
    71→
    72→      if (!useLocalPositions && derivedSlot !== undefined && endGenId && effectiveTimelineData) {
    73→        const endImageInTimeline = effectiveTimelineData[derivedSlot + 1];
    74→        if (endImageInTimeline && endImageInTimeline.generation_id !== endGenId) {
    75→          const endImageNewSlot = effectiveTimelineData.findIndex(
    76→            (item) => item.generation_id === endGenId,
    77→          );
    78→          if (endImageNewSlot === -1 || endImageNewSlot > derivedSlot) {
    79→            derivedSlot = undefined;
    80→            slotSource = 'STALE_END_IMAGE';
    81→          }
    82→        }
    83→      }
    84→    }
    85→
    86→    if (
    87→      derivedSlot === undefined
    88→      && !pairShotGenId
    89→      && typeof childOrder === 'number'
    90→      && childOrder >= 0
    91→      && childOrder < slotCount
    92→    ) {
    93→      derivedSlot = childOrder;
    94→      slotSource = 'CHILD_ORDER';
    95→    }
    96→
    97→    if (slotSource === 'PAIR_AT_END_NO_SLOT') {
    98→      return;
    99→    }
   100→
   101→    if (derivedSlot !== undefined && !usedSlots.has(derivedSlot)) {
   102→      childrenBySlot.set(derivedSlot, child);
   103→      usedSlots.add(derivedSlot);
   104→    } else if (derivedSlot !== undefined && usedSlots.has(derivedSlot)) {
   105→      const existing = childrenBySlot.get(derivedSlot)!;
   106→      if (!existing.location && child.location) {
   107→        childrenBySlot.set(derivedSlot, child);
   108→        childrenWithoutValidSlot.push(existing);
   109→      } else {
   110→        childrenWithoutValidSlot.push(child);
   111→      }
   112→    } else {
   113→      childrenWithoutValidSlot.push(child);
   114→    }
   115→  });
   116→
   117→  for (let i = 0; i < slotCount; i++) {
   118→    const child = childrenBySlot.get(i);
   119→    const liveStartImage = effectiveTimelineData?.[i];
   120→    const liveEndImage = effectiveTimelineData?.[i + 1];
   121→    const pairShotGenerationId = liveStartImage?.id || expectedSegmentData?.pairShotGenIds?.[i];
   122→
   123→    if (child) {
   124→      const childPsgId = getPairIdentifiers(
   125→        child,
   126→        child.params as Record<string, unknown> | null,
   127→      ).pairShotGenId;
   128→      slots.push({
   129→        type: 'child',
   130→        child,
   131→        index: i,
   132→        pairShotGenerationId: childPsgId || pairShotGenerationId,
   133→      });
   134→    } else {
   135→      slots.push({
   136→        type: 'placeholder',
   137→        index: i,
   138→        expectedFrames: expectedSegmentData?.frames[i],
   139→        expectedPrompt: expectedSegmentData?.prompts[i],
   140→        startImage: liveStartImage?.generation_id || expectedSegmentData?.inputImages[i],
   141→        endImage: liveEndImage?.generation_id || expectedSegmentData?.inputImages[i + 1],
   142→        pairShotGenerationId,
   143→      });
   144→    }
   145→  }
   146→
   147→  return slots;
   148→}

    41→export function useLoraPersistence({

    83→    try {
    84→      const lorasToSave = selectedLorasRef.current.map((lora) => ({
    85→        id: lora.id,
    86→        strength: lora.strength,

    88→
    89→      await updatePersistenceSettings('project', {
    90→        loras: lorasToSave,

    95→      markAsUserSet();
    96→      setSaveFlash(false);
    97→      setSaveSuccess(true);

   100→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useLoraManager', showToast: false });
   101→      setSaveFlash(false);

   125→      for (const savedLora of lorasToAdd) {

   137→        }
   138→      });

1→import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
     2→import { ONBOARDING_STEPS } from '@/shared/components/OnboardingModal/data/onboardingSteps';
     3→
     4→export function useOnboardingSteps(isOpen: boolean) {
     5→  const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState(1);
     6→  const [isShaking, setIsShaking] = useState(false);
     7→  const shakeTimeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
     8→
     9→  useEffect(() => {
    10→    if (isOpen) {
    11→      setCurrentStep(1);
    12→    }
    13→  }, [isOpen]);
    14→
    15→  useEffect(() => {
    16→    return () => {
    17→      if (shakeTimeoutRef.current) {
    18→        clearTimeout(shakeTimeoutRef.current);
    19→      }
    20→    };
    21→  }, []);
    22→
    23→  const handleNext = () => {
    24→    setCurrentStep((previous) => Math.min(previous + 1, ONBOARDING_STEPS.length));
    25→  };
    26→
    27→  const handleBack = () => {
    28→    setCurrentStep((previous) => Math.max(previous - 1, 1));
    29→  };
    30→
    31→  const handleShake = () => {
    32→    setIsShaking(true);
    33→    if (shakeTimeoutRef.current) {
    34→      clearTimeout(shakeTimeoutRef.current);
    35→    }
    36→    shakeTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => setIsShaking(false), 500);
    37→  };
    38→
    39→  const currentStepDefinition =
    40→    ONBOARDING_STEPS[currentStep - 1] ?? ONBOARDING_STEPS[0];
    41→  const stepTitles = ONBOARDING_STEPS.map((step) => step.title);
    42→
    43→  return {
    44→    currentStep,
    45→    isShaking,
    46→    handleNext,
    47→    handleBack,
    48→    handleShake,
    49→    currentStepDefinition,
    50→    stepTitles,
    51→  };
    52→}
